name: Commitment To Church
overview: Scripture emphasizes a wholehearted commitment to the church as an expression of trusting and entrusting our lives and works to the Lord, as seen in Psalms 37:5 and Proverbs 16:3 where 'commit' conveys the idea of rolling our ways and works upon God. The early church demonstrated this commitment through steadfast devotion to the apostles' teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread, and prayer (Acts 2:42), living in unity and sharing all things in common (Acts 2:44). Leaders are called to shepherd the church carefully, recognizing it as Christ's purchased flock (Acts 20:28), while faith itself is nurtured through hearing the Word of God (Romans 10:17), underscoring the vital role of the church community in spiritual growth.
